descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre cœur brûle pour la médecine interne large et vous aimez fournir aux patients des soins généraux internes et complets? Alors tu as raison avec nous ! Le KSW est le point de contact médical pour environ 200 000 habitants pour les soins d'urgence et de base en hospitalisation et pour environ 500 000 habitants pour la médecine spécialisée et hautement spécialisée. Nous ne sommes pas divisés en cliniques d'organes. Cela vous offre l'occasion spéciale de rencontrer un potpourri varié et passionnant de maladies internistes chaque jour et de fournir aux patients des soins polyvalents et complets correspondants. Nous sommes heureux de vous soutenir! Non seulement nous maintenons un échange très apprécié et collégial au sein de notre équipe, mais nous travaillons également en étroite collaboration avec nos collègues des soins palliatifs, des soins aigus et des accidents cérébrovasculaires. En outre, nous sommes en échange interdisciplinaire actif avec les autres spécialistes, afin que nous puissions prendre soin de nos patients de la meilleure façon possible et avec soin. Vous pivotez également avec nous sur notre station d'urgence interniste animée et non moins excitante. Nous sommes reconnus pour le Centre d'urgence comme un centre de formation de catégorie IV (patients externes, 1 an) et pour la médecine interne générale catégorie A (patients hospitalisés, 3 ans). Bienvenue dans l'équipe ! Tâches :
• Vous traitez et soignez les patients ainsi que les patients sur les postes de lit de la Clinique de Médecine Interne
• Vous prendrez soin du triage, de l'évaluation et des soins initiaux des patients de toutes les spécialités médicales du centre d'urgence
• Vous travaillez comme consulat dans les cliniques chirurgicales du KSW
• Vous transmettez votre expérience en éducation et formation Profil :
• Vous êtes spécialiste en médecine interne générale et avez une expérience professionnelle en Suisse
• Vous êtes inspiré par des problèmes internes complexes et des traitements complets pour les patients
• Vous êtes engagé et aimez travailler en équipe et convaincre avec votre motivation et vos compétences sociales
• La formation de nos jeunes médecins adjoints est une grande préoccupation pour vous et vous êtes heureux de transmettre vos connaissances Avantages: KSW offre aux employés des conditions qui leur permettent de concilier leurs objectifs professionnels et leurs besoins personnels. Des horaires de travail flexibles et flexibles, un bureau à domicile ainsi qu'un congé de maternité généreux et des niveaux d'emploi adaptés à différentes situations – tout cela est possible chez KSW, tant que l'entreprise le permet. Chaque année, le KSW propose 40 formations interdisciplinaires et 50 formations professionnelles. Nous vous soutenons également dans le temps et/ou financièrement avec une formation externe; Dans des situations extraordinaires, p. ex. maladie prolongée de B., stress personnel grave ou expériences difficiles dans la vie privée ainsi que dans le travail quotidien, diverses offres de conversation sont disponibles pour vous. La coopération reconnaissante et amicale au sein des équipes et des départements caractérise l'atmosphère de travail de KSW. Comme signe d'un esprit d'équipe fort, le -you , a été introduit comme un standard chez KSW. De plus, le KSW soutient financièrement les activités annuelles de l'équipe et organise tous les quatre ans un important événement de dotation pour toute la maison. Les employés de KSW bénéficient de très bons avantages sociaux. Ainsi, la solution de fonds de pension avec BVK est bien au-dessus du minimum légal. Même en cas de maladie ou d'accident, les employés de KSW sont très bien couverts. Avec des réductions sur les abonnements de fitness, des possibilités de formation interne et des cours, avantages dans les pharmacies ainsi que dans les compagnies d'assurance santé les plus populaires. Vous pouvez bénéficier d'une offre complète pour votre santé; Notre garderie La Luna avec des heures d'ouverture spacieuses est situé à côté de la KSW. En outre, vous pouvez utiliser le soutien financier dépendant du revenu de la KSW pour les coûts du berceau. En collaboration avec des partenaires culturels à Winterthur et aux alentours, nous offrons régulièrement des réductions pour les concerts et les spectacles de théâtre. descriptionByLocale.en:
The Department of Nuclear Medicine and PET/CT in the Department of Radiology and Nuclear Medicine makes a significant contribution to the interdisciplinary treatment of patients at KSW. We carry out around 8000 examinations every year and cover almost the full range of nuclear medicine diagnostics and therapy. The offer is constantly expanded to meet the needs of patients. For our team, we are looking for a person who shares his passion for nuclear medicine with us. Tasks:
• Care of outpatient and inpatient patients in the context of diagnostic and therapeutic services
• Independent conduct of studies in conventional nuclear medicine, SPECT/CT and PET/CT as well as work in the nuclear medicine hot laboratory
• Collaboration in various nuclear medicine consultation hours
• Support of vocational trainers in the training of students Profile:
• You are passionate about molecular imaging and therapy
• You have a federal degree as a dipl. Radiology specialist HF or an equivalent recognised by the SRC
• You preferably have professional experience in nuclear medicine, including SPECT/CT and PET/CT
• You are a motivated, independent and communication-strong personality
• Collegial cooperation in the team and taking on responsibility are a matter of course for you
• Your way of working is characterized by care and quality awareness
• Customer-oriented communication with patients and referees is important to you
• You have good to very good knowledge of German (at least B2) Benefits: KSW offers employees conditions that enable them to reconcile their professional goals and personal needs. Flexible, flexible working hours, home office as well as a generous maternity leave and employment levels adapted to different situations – all this is possible at KSW, as long as the company allows it. Every year, the KSW offers 40 interdisciplinary and 50 professional training courses. We also support you temporally and/or financially with external training.; In extraordinary situations, e.g. B. prolonged illness, severe personal stress or difficult experiences in private life as well as in everyday work, various offers of conversation are available to you.; The appreciative and friendly cooperation within the teams and across the departments characterizes the working atmosphere at KSW. As a sign of a strong team spirit, the “you” was introduced as a standard at KSW. In addition, the KSW supports annual team events financially and organizes a large staffing event for the whole house every four years. KSW employees benefit from very good social benefits. Thus, the pension fund solution with BVK is far above the legal minimum. Even in the event of illness or accident, KSW employees are very well covered.; With discounts on fitness subscriptions, internal training opportunities and course offers, perks in pharmacies as well as at the most popular health insurance companies. You can benefit from a comprehensive offer for your health.; Our daycare center La Luna with spacious opening hours is located next to the KSW. In addition, you can use the income-dependent, financial support from the KSW for the crib costs.; In cooperation with cultural partners in and around Winterthur, we regularly offer discounts for concerts and theater performances. The borrowing of media in the in-house library is also free of charge for employees.
• Professional field: MTTB (med. techn. therapeut). Occupations
• Area: Clinic for Radiology and Nuclear Medicine
• Pensum: 80-100 %

jobs.description:
Für die Geriatrie suchen wir per 1. September 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und motivierte Persönlichkeit als Oberärztin / Oberarzt. Das Kantonsspital Winterthur liegt zentral, nur 30 Minuten von Zürich und von der deutschen Grenze entfernt. Mit einem Einzugsgebiet von über 200‘000 Einwohnern verfügt es über alle wichtigen Fachdisziplinen und ist für die Grundversorgung sowie die hochspezialisierte Medizin der Grossregion Winterthur verantwortlich. Der Fachbereich Endokrinologie/Diabetologie am Kantonsspital Winterthur umfasst ein Ambulatorium mit moderner Infrastruktur und einen Konsiliardienst mit Ausrichtung auf das gesamte Spektrum hormoneller Erkrankungen inkl. Diabetes mellitus und Adipositas.

Aufgaben:
• Du betreust Patientinnen und Patienten mit dem gesamten Spektrum endokrinologischer und diabetologischer Erkrankungen, sowohl im Rahmen einer ambulanten Sprechstunde als auch einer fachbereichsübergreifenden Konsiliartätigkeit
• Du wirkst mit an interdisziplinären und interprofessionellen Besprechungen und Weiterbildungen und bist mitverantwortlich für die Supervision von Assistenzärztinnen und Assistenzärzten sowie von Ernährungs- und Diabetesberaterinnen
• Du übernimmst Führungsaufgaben, wie das Tutoring von Assistenzärztinnen und Assistenzärzten und organisatorische Tätigkeiten

Profil:
• Du bist Fachärztin / Facharzt für Endokrinologie/Diabetologie
• Die interdisziplinäre und interprofessionelle Zusammenarbeit erlebst du als Bereicherung. Du hast Teamgeist, bist respektvoll und loyal im Umgang und verfügst über eine hohe soziale Kompetenz
• Du hast Organisationsgeschick, bist gut strukturiert und die Aus- und Weiterbildung junger Kolleginnen und Kollegen macht dir Spass

Benefits: Das KSW bietet den Mitarbeitenden Bedingungen, die es ihnen ermöglichen, ihre beruflichen Ziele und persönlichen Bedürfnisse in Einklang zu bringen. Flexible, gleitende Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice sowie ein grosszügiger Mutterschaftsurlaub und an verschiedene Lebenslagen angepasste Beschäftigungsgrade – das ist alles möglich am KSW, sofern es der Betrieb zulässt.; Jährlich bietet das KSW 40 überfachliche und 50 fachliche Fortbildungen an. Auch bei externen Weiterbildungen unterstützen wir dich zeitlich und/oder finanziell.; In ausserordentlichen Situationen, wie z. B. längerer Krankheit, starker persönlicher Belastung oder schwierigen Erlebnissen im Privaten sowie im Berufsalltag, stehen dir diverse Gesprächsangebote zur Verfügung.; Die wertschätzende und freundliche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Teams und über die Abteilungen hinweg zeichnet das Arbeitsklima am KSW aus. Als Zeichen für einen starken Teamgedanken wurde am KSW das «Du» als Standard eingeführt. Ausserdem unterstützt das KSW jährliche Team-Events finanziell und veranstaltet alle vier Jahre ein grosses Personalfest für das ganze Haus.; Mitarbeitende des KSW profitieren von sehr guten Sozialleistungen. So liegt die Pensionskassenlösung mit der BVK weit über dem gesetzlichen Minimum. Auch im Falle von Krankheit oder Unfall sind KSW-Mitarbeitende sehr gut abgesichert.; Mit Rabatten auf Fitness-Abonnements, internen Trainingsmöglichkeiten und Kursangeboten, Vergünstigungen in Apotheken sowie bei den beliebtesten Krankenkassen. Du kannst von einem umfassenden Angebot für deine Gesundheit profitieren.; Unsere Kindertagesstätte La Luna mit grosszügigen Öffnungszeiten befindet sich direkt neben dem KSW. Zudem kannst du die einkommensabhängige, finanzielle Unterstützung durch das KSW für die Krippenkosten nutzen.; In Zusammenarbeit mit Kulturpartnern in und um Winterthur bieten wir regelmässig Vergünstigungen für Konzerte und Theatervorstellungen. Die Ausleihe von Medien in der hauseigenen Bibliothek ist für Mitarbeitende zudem kostenlos.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per rafforzare il nostro team medico, stiamo cercando un medico senior / un medico superiore endocrinologia e diabetica con una prospettiva possibile sull'assunzione di compiti di leadership all'interno del centro tiroideo. L'Ospedale cantonale Winterthur si trova in posizione centrale a soli 30 minuti da Zurigo e dal confine tedesco. Con un’area di cattura di oltre 200’000 abitanti, ha tutte le principali discipline ed è responsabile della cura di base e della medicina altamente specializzata del Grossregion Winterthur. Il Dipartimento di Endocrinologia/Diabetologia presso l'Ospedale cantonale di Winterthur comprende un ambulatorio con infrastrutture moderne e un servizio consiliare con orientamento all'intero spettro di malattie ormonali incl. Diabete mellito e obesità. Compiti:
• Tratta i pazienti con l'intero spettro di disturbi endocrinologici e diabetologici, sia nel contesto di una lezione di discorso ambulatorio che di attività consiliare interdisciplinare
• Lavorare con incontri interdisciplinari e interprofessionali e formazione ulteriore e sono co-responsabili per la supervisione di medici assistenti e consiglieri nutrizionali e di diabete
• Si assumono compiti di leadership, come la tutoraggio di medici assistenti e attività organizzative Profilo:
• Sei uno specialista in endocrinologia/diabetologia
• Vivi la cooperazione interdisciplinare e interprofessionale come arricchimento. Hai spirito di squadra, sei rispettoso e leale nel gestire e avere un'alta competenza sociale
• Hai competenze organizzative, sono ben strutturate e la formazione di giovani colleghi ti fa divertire Vantaggi: Il KSW offre ai dipendenti condizioni che permettono loro di allineare i loro obiettivi professionali e le loro esigenze personali. Ore di lavoro flessibili e scorrevoli, ufficio domestico e un generoso congedo di maternità e livelli di occupazione adattati a diverse situazioni di vita – questo è tutto possibile al KSW se permette l'operazione; Ogni anno, il KSW offre 40 straordinari e 50 corsi di formazione professionale. Vi sosteniamo anche negli sviluppi esterni nel tempo e/o nei termini finanziari; In situazioni eccezionali, ad esempio malattia più lunga, forte peso personale o esperienze difficili nel privato e nella vita professionale quotidiana, si hanno varie offerte di conversazione disponibili. La preziosa e amichevole collaborazione all'interno delle squadre e nei dipartimenti è caratterizzata dal clima di lavoro al KSW. Come segno di una forte idea di squadra, il "Du" è stato introdotto come standard al KSW. Inoltre, il KSW supporta eventi di squadra annuali finanziariamente e organizza un grande festival del personale per tutta la casa ogni quattro anni; i dipendenti KSW beneficiano di benefici sociali molto buoni. Così, la soluzione dei fondi pensione con il BVK è ben al di sopra del minimo legale. Anche in caso di malattia o incidente, i dipendenti KSW sono molto ben protetti; Con sconti su abbonamenti di fitness, opzioni di formazione interna e offerte di corso, sconti in farmacie e tra le più popolari compagnie di assicurazione sanitaria. È possibile beneficiare di un'offerta completa per la vostra salute; Il nostro centro di cura La Luna con orari generosi di apertura si trova proprio accanto al KSW. È inoltre possibile utilizzare il sostegno finanziario e dipendente dal reddito fornito dal KSW per i costi della culla; In collaborazione con partner culturali di Winterthur e dintorni offriamo regolarmente sconti per concerti e spettacoli teatrali. Il prestito dei media nella biblioteca interna è gratuito anche per i dipendenti.
• Campo professionale: medici
• Area: Dipartimento di Endocrinologia/Diabetologia
• Pensum: 80-100%
descriptionByLocale.en:
To strengthen our doctor team, we are looking for a senior physician / an upper physician endocrinology & diabetics with a possible perspective on the takeover of leadership tasks within the thyroid center. The Cantonal Hospital Winterthur is centrally located just 30 minutes from Zurich and from the German border. With a catchment area of more than 200’000 inhabitants, it has all major disciplines and is responsible for the basic care and highly specialized medicine of the Grossregion Winterthur. The Department of Endocrinology/Diabetology at the Cantonal Hospital of Winterthur includes an ambulatory with modern infrastructure and a consiliary service with orientation to the entire spectrum of hormonal diseases incl. Diabetes mellitus and obesity. Tasks:
• You treat patients with the entire spectrum of endocrinological and diabetological disorders, both in the context of an outpatient speech lesson and interdisciplinary consiliar activity
• You work with interdisciplinary and interprofessional meetings and further training and are co-responsible for the supervision of assistant physicians and nutritional and diabetes advisers
• You take leadership tasks, such as the tutoring of assistant physicians and organizational activities Profile:
• You are a specialist in endocrinology/diabetology
• You experience interdisciplinary and interprofessional cooperation as an enrichment. You have team spirit, are respectful and loyal in handling and have a high social competence
• You have organisational skills, are well structured and the training of young colleagues makes you fun Benefits: The KSW offers the employees conditions that enable them to align their professional goals and personal needs. Flexible, sliding working hours, home office as well as a generous maternity leave and levels of employment adapted to different situations of life – this is all possible at the KSW if it permits the operation; Every year, the KSW offers 40 overtime and 50 professional training courses. We also support you in external developments in time and/or financial terms; In exceptional situations, e.g. longer illness, strong personal burden or difficult experiences in the private and in the everyday professional life, you have various conversation offers available. The valuable and friendly cooperation within the teams and across the departments is characterized by the working climate at the KSW. As a sign for a strong team idea, the "Du" was introduced as a standard at the KSW. In addition, the KSW supports annual team events financially and organizes a large staff festival for the whole house every four years; KSW employees benefit from very good social benefits. Thus, the pension funds solution with the BVK is far above the statutory minimum. Even in the event of illness or accident, KSW employees are very well secured; With discounts on fitness subscriptions, internal training options and course offers, discounts in pharmacies and among the most popular health insurance companies. You can benefit from a comprehensive offer for your health; Our La Luna daycare centre with generous opening hours is located right next to the KSW. You can also use the income-dependent, financial support provided by the KSW for the crib costs; In cooperation with cultural partners in and around Winterthur we regularly offer discounts for concerts and theatre performances. The borrowing of media in the in-house library is also free for employees.
• Professional field: doctors
• Area: Department of Endocrinology/Diabetology
• Pensum: 80-100%

Pour renforcer notre équipe de médecins, nous cherchons un médecin senior / un médecin supérieur endocrinologie et diabétiques avec une perspective possible sur la reprise des tâches de leadership au sein du centre de thyroïde. L'hôpital cantonal Winterthur est situé à seulement 30 minutes de Zurich et de la frontière allemande. Avec un bassin versant de plus de 200 000 habitants, il a toutes les disciplines majeures et est responsable des soins de base et de la médecine hautement spécialisée de la Grossregion Winterthur. Le département d'endocrinologie/diabétologie de l'hôpital cantonal de Winterthur comprend une ambulatoire avec une infrastructure moderne et un service consiliaire avec orientation vers l'ensemble du spectre des maladies hormonales, y compris. Diabète sucré et obésité. Tâches:
• Vous traitez les patients avec l'ensemble du spectre des troubles endocrinologiques et diabétéologiques, à la fois dans le contexte d'une leçon de langage ambulatoire et d'une activité consiliaire interdisciplinaire

• Vous assumez des tâches de leadership, telles que le tutorat des médecins adjoints et les activités organisationnelles Profil:

• Vous vivez une coopération interdisciplinaire et interprofessionnelle en tant qu'enrichissement. Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe, êtes respectueux et loyal dans la gestion et avez une haute compétence sociale
• Vous avez des compétences organisationnelles, sont bien structurés et la formation de jeunes collègues vous rend amusant Avantages : Le KSW offre aux employés des conditions qui leur permettent d'aligner leurs objectifs professionnels et leurs besoins personnels. Nous vous soutenons également dans les développements extérieurs en temps et/ou en termes financiers; Dans des situations exceptionnelles, par exemple une maladie plus longue, un lourd fardeau personnel ou des expériences difficiles dans le privé et dans la vie professionnelle quotidienne, vous avez diverses offres de conversation disponibles. La coopération précieuse et amicale au sein des équipes et dans l'ensemble des départements se caractérise par le climat de travail au KSW. Comme signe d'une forte idée d'équipe, le "Du" a été introduit comme standard au KSW. En outre, le KSW soutient financièrement les événements annuels de l'équipe et organise un grand festival du personnel pour toute la maison tous les quatre ans. Ainsi, la solution des fonds de pension avec le BVK est bien supérieure au minimum légal. Même en cas de maladie ou d'accident, les employés de KSW sont très bien protégés; Avec des réductions sur les abonnements de fitness, des options de formation interne et des offres de cours, des réductions dans les pharmacies et parmi les compagnies d'assurance santé les plus populaires. Vous pouvez bénéficier d'une offre complète pour votre santé; Notre garderie La Luna avec des heures d'ouverture généreuses est situé juste à côté de la KSW. Vous pouvez également utiliser le soutien financier lié au revenu fourni par le KSW pour les frais de literie; En collaboration avec des partenaires culturels à Winterthur et aux alentours, nous offrons régulièrement des réductions pour les concerts et les spectacles de théâtre. Du suchst die Herausforderung im Umgang mit schnell wechselnden Situationen und komplexen Fragestellungen. Du hast Freude an der selbständigen und interdisziplinären Betreuung von Personen aus allen Altersgruppen, unterschiedlicher sozio-kultureller Herkunft und mit unterschiedlichen Erkrankungs- und Verletzungsgraden.

Aufgaben:
• Die fachgerechte und umfassende Pflege auf der Notfallstation verlangt hohes fachliches Wissen und Sozialkompetenz. Du sorgst für das physische und psychische Wohlbefinden und für die Sicherheit der Patientinnen und Patienten
• Der Umgang mit rasch wechselnden Situationen und das Verständnis für Menschen in aussergewöhnlichen Momenten gehört zum Arbeitsalltag einer Expertin/eines Experten Notfallpflege Nachdiplomstudium (NDS) HF

descriptionByLocale.en:
You love working in a lively environment, want to be part of a great team and value regular working hours during the week? Then you are right with us! At the medical polyclinic, we treat outpatient patients together, carry out personnel medical checks and offer a consultation for travel medicine.

Tasks:
• As a hub of the clinic, you are responsible for smooth processes and the entire organization of office hours (patient reception, appointment planning, telephone service, mail management)
• You carry out diagnostic and therapeutic measures from blood sampling to infusions, vaccinations and ECG, 24h BD measurements to assistance with punctures
• You are a responsible contact person for internal personnel issues. In addition, you are responsible for organizing trustworthy assessments of students of external training institutions
• We maintain an electronic agenda and medical history (KISIM). General administrative activities are part of your everyday life

Profile:
• You are motivated and capable of teamwork
• You have completed MPA vocational training with several years of professional experience
• You have a quick understanding.
• You are reliable and distinguished by your commitment, flexibility and openness
• Working on the PC is an ease for you
• You are a team player with a strong patient orientation and want to actively shape changes

Benefits: KSW offers employees conditions that enable them to reconcile their professional goals and personal needs. Flexible, flexible working hours, home office as well as a generous maternity leave and employment levels adapted to different situations – all this is possible at KSW, as long as the company allows it. Every year, the KSW offers 40 interdisciplinary and 50 professional training courses. We also support you temporally and/or financially for external training.; In extraordinary situations, e.g. B. prolonged illness, severe personal stress or difficult experiences in private life as well as in everyday work, various offers of conversation are available to you.; The appreciative and friendly cooperation within the teams and across the departments characterizes the working atmosphere at KSW. As a sign of a strong team spirit, the “you” was introduced as a standard at KSW. In addition, the KSW supports annual team events financially and organizes a large staffing event for the whole house every four years. KSW employees benefit from very good social benefits. Thus, the pension fund solution with BVK is far above the legal minimum. Even in the event of illness or accident, KSW employees are very well covered.; With discounts on fitness subscriptions, internal training opportunities and course offers, perks in pharmacies as well as at the most popular health insurance companies. You can benefit from a comprehensive offer for your health.; Our daycare center La Luna with spacious opening hours is located directly next to the KSW. In addition, you can use the income-dependent, financial support from the KSW for the crib costs.; In cooperation with cultural partners in and around Winterthur, we regularly offer discounts for concerts and theatre performances. The borrowing of media in the in-house library is also free of charge for employees.

• Pensum: 60-80 %

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un médecin senior dermatologie et vénérologie FMH avec intérêt ou expertise prouvée en allergologie et immunologie clinique. Dermatologie et allergologie à l'hôpital cantonal Winterthur (KSW) est le centre régional de compétence pour le diagnostic et le traitement de l'ensemble des maladies dermatologiques et des problèmes allergologiques. Nous prenons soin des patients externes et hospitalisés à un niveau professionnel élevé et travaillons en étroite collaboration avec de nombreuses disciplines médicales dans un hôpital de centre moderne. En tant que centre de formation de la FMH en dermatologie et en vénérologie (catégorie C), nous combinons d'excellents soins aux patients avec une éducation engagée, une formation continue et une formation continue. Dans le cadre du développement stratégique de notre département, nous sommes à la recherche d'une personnalité entrepreneuriale qui aime façonner activement l'avenir de la dermatologie et de l'allergologie chez KSW et qui peut apporter sa propre orientation spécialisée.

Tâches :
• Gestion indépendante d'une consultation dermatologique variée avec l'ensemble du spectre de dermatologie générale
• Diagnostic et traitement des questions allergologiques en fonction de ses propres qualifications et intérêts
• Mise en œuvre de consilies dermatologiques fixes chez KSW ainsi que dans nos institutions partenaires
• Participation active et développement des services dermatologiques et allergologiques
• Représentation de la dermatologie dans les heures de consultation interdisciplinaire et les conseils (y compris le centre vasculaire, la chirurgie plastique, les conseils de vascularite)
• Développement et développement de priorités techniques propres
• Leadership professionnel et humain au sein de l'équipe
• Formation et perfectionnement des médecins auxiliaires et promotion des jeunes dermatologues
• Engagement dans l'enseignement, la formation, l'assurance de la qualité et l'entretien du réseau

Profil :
• Titre du spécialiste Dermatologie et Vénérologie FMH ou qualification équivalente reconnue en Suisse (MEBEKO)
• Plusieurs années d'expérience clinique, idéalement dans une fonction senior ou senior
• Large expertise clinique en dermatologie générale
• Une expertise avérée ou un intérêt particulier pour l'allergologie et l'immunologie clinique est bienvenu, mais aucune exigence
• Profitez de la coopération interdisciplinaire et du développement du département
• Orientation élevée du patient, force de communication et travail d'équipe
• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture
• Désir de construire des choses, établir des normes et aider à façonner un profil

Avantages: KSW offre aux employés des conditions qui leur permettent de concilier leurs objectifs professionnels et leurs besoins personnels. Des horaires de travail flexibles et flexibles, un bureau à domicile ainsi qu'un congé de maternité généreux et des niveaux d'emploi adaptés à différentes situations – tout cela est possible chez KSW, tant que l'entreprise le permet. Chaque année, le KSW propose 40 formations interdisciplinaires et 50 formations professionnelles. Nous vous soutenons également dans le temps et/ou financièrement avec une formation externe; Dans des situations extraordinaires, p. ex. maladie prolongée de B., stress personnel grave ou expériences difficiles dans la vie privée ainsi que dans le travail quotidien, diverses offres de conversation sont disponibles pour vous. La coopération reconnaissante et amicale au sein des équipes et des départements caractérise l'atmosphère de travail de KSW. Comme signe d'un esprit d'équipe fort, le -you , a été introduit comme un standard chez KSW. De plus, le KSW soutient financièrement les activités annuelles de l'équipe et organise tous les quatre ans un important événement de dotation pour toute la maison. Les employés de KSW bénéficient de très bons avantages sociaux. Ainsi, la solution de fonds de pension avec BVK est bien au-dessus du minimum légal. Même en cas de maladie ou d'accident, les employés de KSW sont très bien couverts. Avec des réductions sur les abonnements de fitness, des possibilités de formation interne et des cours, avantages dans les pharmacies ainsi que dans les compagnies d'assurance santé les plus populaires. Vous pouvez bénéficier d'une offre complète pour votre santé; Notre garderie La Luna avec des heures d'ouverture spacieuses est situé à côté de la KSW. En outre, vous pouvez utiliser le soutien financier dépendant du revenu de la KSW pour les coûts du berceau. En collaboration avec des partenaires culturels à Winterthur et aux alentours, nous offrons régulièrement des réductions pour les concerts et les spectacles de théâtre. L'emprunt des médias dans la bibliothèque interne est également gratuit pour les employés.

• Domaine professionnel: Médecins
• Domaine de spécialisation Allergologie/Dermatologie
• Pensum: 80-100 %

descriptionByLocale.it:
I nostri tre centri di lavoro sono i fornitori di servizi centrali all'interno della chirurgia. In ciascuna di 25 sale di esame, i pazienti sono curati da varie cliniche chirurgiche e altre aree ambulatoriali. Per le ore di ufficio stiamo cercando 1. 2026 o d'accordo una persona dedicata e orientata al servizio che rappresenterà il dipartimento di gestione. Insieme al nostro piccolo e motivato team, avrete l'opportunità di contribuire le vostre qualità professionali e umane in un ambiente di lavoro vario e interessante. Si può aspettare un'introduzione attenta a tutte le attività e i nostri vari processi. Anche nel settore della leadership è una gestione dipartimentale benevola e aperta, che vi supporta attivamente nel vostro sviluppo personale e professionale. Offriamo anche un posto di lavoro moderno in un ambiente ospedaliero vivace. Non vediamo l'ora di vederti!

Compiti:
• Assicurare il funzionamento regolare del centro orario ufficio nel team
• Accoglienza e cura dei pazienti delle ore di consultazione speciali e private
• Registrazione e gestione dei dati del paziente e coordinamento degli esami preliminari
• Organizzazione, ricostituzione e ordinazione di materiali e medicinali medici
• Supporto amministrativo per i pazienti e partecipazione attiva all'ottimizzazione dei processi
• Supporto attivo della gestione del dipartimento nelle attività di gestione
• Introduzione dei nuovi dipendenti

Profilo:
• Hai una formazione come receptionist / receptionist o uno sfondo professionale simile
• Hai una buona conoscenza delle applicazioni IT
• Idealmente, hai già esperienza nel settore sanitario
• Un approccio orientato al paziente è una questione naturalmente per voi
• Sei un talento organizzativo e tieni sempre una panoramica
• Hai un metodo di lavoro affidabile e preciso
• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco, altre competenze linguistiche straniere sono un vantaggio
• Ti dà piacere di ruotare nei tre centri dell'ufficio ore
• Sei una personalità empatica, impegnata e autentica che idealmente già ha esperienza di leadership

Vantaggi: KSW offre ai dipendenti condizioni che permettono loro di conciliare i loro obiettivi professionali e le esigenze personali. Orario di lavoro flessibile e flessibile, ufficio domestico, nonché un generoso congedo di maternità e livelli di occupazione adattati a situazioni diverse – tutto questo è possibile a KSW, fino a quando l'azienda lo permette. Ogni anno, il KSW offre 40 corsi di formazione interdisciplinari e 50 corsi di formazione professionale. Vi sosteniamo anche nel tempo e/o finanziariamente con la formazione esterna.; In situazioni straordinarie, ad esempio B. malattia prolungata, grave stress personale o esperienze difficili nella vita privata, così come nel lavoro quotidiano, varie offerte di conversazione sono a vostra disposizione.; La collaborazione apprezzata e amichevole all'interno delle squadre e nei dipartimenti caratterizza l'atmosfera di lavoro a KSW. Come segno di un forte spirito di squadra, il “tu” è stato introdotto come standard a KSW. Inoltre, il KSW supporta eventi di squadra annuali finanziariamente e organizza un grande evento di personale per tutta la casa ogni quattro anni. I dipendenti KSW beneficiano di benefici sociali molto buoni. Così, la soluzione di fondo pensionistico con BVK è molto superiore al minimo legale. Anche in caso di malattia o incidente, i dipendenti KSW sono molto ben coperti.; Con sconti su abbonamenti di fitness, opportunità di formazione interna e offerte di corso, vantaggi in farmacie e presso le più popolari compagnie di assicurazione sanitaria. È possibile beneficiare di un'offerta completa per la vostra salute.; Il nostro centro diurno La Luna con ampie ore di apertura si trova vicino al KSW. Inoltre, è possibile utilizzare il reddito dipendente, il sostegno finanziario dalla KSW per i costi della culla.; In collaborazione con partner culturali di Winterthur e dintorni, offriamo regolarmente sconti per concerti e spettacoli teatrali. Il prestito dei media nella biblioteca interna è anche gratuito per i dipendenti.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Our three office hours centres are the central service providers within surgery. In each of 25 examination rooms, patients are looked after by various surgical clinics and other outpatient areas. For the office hours we are looking for 1. 2026 or by agreement a dedicated and service-oriented person who will represent the department management. Together with our small, motivated team, you will have the opportunity to contribute your professional and human qualities in a diverse and interesting working environment. You can expect a careful introduction to all tasks and our various processes. Also in the area of leadership is a benevolent and open departmental management, which actively supports you in your personal and professional development. We also offer a modern workplace in a lively hospital environment. We look forward to seeing you!

Tasks:
• Ensuring the smooth operation of the office hour centre in the team
• Reception and care of patients of the special and private consultation hours
• Recording and management of patient data and coordination of preliminary examinations
• Organisation, replenishment and ordering of medical materials and medicines
• Administrative support for patients and active participation in process optimization
• Active support of the department management in management tasks
• Introduction of new employees

Profile:
• You have an education as a receptionist/receptionist or a similar professional background
• You have good IT application knowledge
• Ideally, you already have experience in healthcare
• A patient-oriented approach is a matter of course for you
• You are an organizational talent and keep an overview at all times
• You have a reliable and exact working method
• You have very good knowledge of German, other foreign language skills are an advantage
• It gives you pleasure to rotate in the three office hours centers
• You are an empathetic, committed and authentic personality who ideally already has leadership experience

Benefits: KSW offers employees conditions that enable them to reconcile their professional goals and personal needs. Flexible, flexible working hours, home office as well as a generous maternity leave and employment levels adapted to different situations – all this is possible at KSW, as long as the company allows it. Every year, the KSW offers 40 interdisciplinary and 50 professional training courses. We also support you temporally and/or financially with external training.; In extraordinary situations, e.g. B. prolonged illness, severe personal stress or difficult experiences in private life as well as in everyday work, various offers of conversation are available to you.; The appreciative and friendly cooperation within the teams and across the departments characterizes the working atmosphere at KSW. As a sign of a strong team spirit, the “you” was introduced as a standard at KSW. In addition, the KSW supports annual team events financially and organizes a large staffing event for the whole house every four years. KSW employees benefit from very good social benefits. Thus, the pension fund solution with BVK is far above the legal minimum. Even in the event of illness or accident, KSW employees are very well covered.; With discounts on fitness subscriptions, internal training opportunities and course offers, perks in pharmacies as well as at the most popular health insurance companies. You can benefit from a comprehensive offer for your health.; Our daycare center La Luna with spacious opening hours is located next to the KSW. In addition, you can use the income-dependent, financial support from the KSW for the crib costs.; In cooperation with cultural partners in and around Winterthur, we regularly offer discounts for concerts and theater performances. The borrowing of media in the in-house library is also free of charge for employees.

• Area: Care surgery
• Pensum: 80 %

jobs.description:
Das Fachärztezentrum Glatt ist eine multidisziplinäre moderne Praxis, welche durch das Kantonsspital Winterthur betrieben wird. Als Ergänzung für unser sympathisches Team suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine Leitende Med. Praxisassistentin / einen Leitenden Med. Praxisassistenten. Wir bieten dir ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit viel Entwicklungspotential. Die Praxis ist Montag bis Freitag geöffnet, wir leisten keinen Notfalldienst und haben fünf Wochen Ferien. Der Arbeitsort befindet sich im Einkaufzentrum Glatt, womit auch du von dessen Mitarbeitervorteilen wie z.B. Vergünstigungen in diversen Geschäften und einem Gratisparkplatz profitierst.

Aufgaben:
• Personelle, fachliche und organisatorische Führung des MPA-Teams und der Lernenden
• Verantwortung über die internen und externen Qualitätskontrollen zusammen mit der Praxiskoordinatorin
• Rekrutierung neuer Mitarbeitenden zusammen mit der Praxiskoordinatorin sowie Einführung dieser
• Einführung und Umsetzung des Betriebskonzeptes
• Optimierung von Arbeitsprozessen im MPA-Bereich sowie Umsetzung von kleinen Projekten
• Regelmässiger Austausch mit dem betriebswirtschaftlichen Support, der Praxiskoordinatorin sowie der ärztlichen Leitung
• Zusätzlich übernimmst du Aufgaben als MPA im Praxisalltag, wie die Sprechstundenassistenz für diverse Fachrichtungen wie z.B. Handchirurgie, Gynäkologie, Hausarztmedizin, plastische Chirurgie, Viszeralchirurgie, Neurochirurgie und Gefässchirurgie
• Ebenso hast du die Möglichkeit bei chirurgischen Eingriffen in Lokalanästhesie oder auch in Vollnarkose zu assistieren
• Nebst der Durchführung von Blutentnahmen und Laboranalysen sorgst du für eine reibungslose Sprechstundenplanung
• Am Empfang bist du für die Anmeldung der Patientinnen / Patienten sowie für telefonische Auskünfte zuständig

Profil:
• Du besitzt das EFZ zur/zum Med. Praxisassistent/in und hast die Weiterbildung zur/zum Med. Praxiskoordinator/in idealerweise bereits erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder befindest dich aktuell in der Weiterbildung
• Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit Führungskompetenz, ausserdem zeichnest du dich aus durch Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Sozialkompetenz, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität und besitzt eine hohe Dienstleistungsorientierung
• Du führst mit Leidenschaft und bewältigst mit Organisationstalent die administrativen Aufgaben
• Du bist ein Teamplayer und begegnest dem ganzen Team auf Augenhöhe
• Gute MS Office Kenntnisse, Grundkenntnisse von Klinikinformationssystemen sowie Eigeninitiative runden dein Profil ab

Benefits: Das KSW bietet den Mitarbeitenden Bedingungen, die es ihnen ermöglichen, ihre beruflichen Ziele und persönlichen Bedürfnisse in Einklang zu bringen. Flexible, gleitende Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice sowie ein grosszügiger Mutterschaftsurlaub und an verschiedene Lebenslagen angepasste Beschäftigungsgrade – das ist alles möglich am KSW, sofern es der Betrieb zulässt.; Jährlich bietet das KSW 40 überfachliche und 50 fachliche Fortbildungen an. Auch bei externen Weiterbildungen unterstützen wir dich zeitlich und/oder finanziell.; In ausserordentlichen Situationen, wie z. B. längerer Krankheit, starker persönlicher Belastung oder schwierigen Erlebnissen im Privaten sowie im Berufsalltag, stehen dir diverse Gesprächsangebote zur Verfügung.; Die wertschätzende und freundliche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Teams und über die Abteilungen hinweg zeichnet das Arbeitsklima am KSW aus. Als Zeichen für einen starken Teamgedanken wurde am KSW das «Du» als Standard eingeführt. Ausserdem unterstützt das KSW jährliche Team-Events finanziell und veranstaltet alle vier Jahre ein grosses Personalfest für das ganze Haus.; Mitarbeitende des KSW profitieren von sehr guten Sozialleistungen. So liegt die Pensionskassenlösung mit der BVK weit über dem gesetzlichen Minimum. Auch im Falle von Krankheit oder Unfall sind KSW-Mitarbeitende sehr gut abgesichert.; Mit Rabatten auf Fitness-Abonnements, internen Trainingsmöglichkeiten und Kursangeboten, Vergünstigungen in Apotheken sowie bei den beliebtesten Krankenkassen. Du kannst von einem umfassenden Angebot für deine Gesundheit profitieren.; Unsere Kindertagesstätte La Luna mit grosszügigen Öffnungszeiten befindet sich direkt neben dem KSW. Zudem kannst du die einkommensabhängige, finanzielle Unterstützung durch das KSW für die Krippenkosten nutzen.; In Zusammenarbeit mit Kulturpartnern in und um Winterthur bieten wir regelmässig Vergünstigungen für Konzerte und Theatervorstellungen. Die Ausleihe von Medien in der hauseigenen Bibliothek ist für Mitarbeitende zudem kostenlos.

• Berufsfeld: MPA / Arztsekretariate
• Bereich: Fachärztezentrum Glatt
• Pensum: 80-100%

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il centro medico specializzato Glatt è una pratica moderna multidisciplinare operata dall'Ospedale cantonale Winterthur. Come integratore per la nostra squadra simpatica, stiamo cercando un Med Lead. Praxisassistentin / Lead Med. Praxis assistenten al 1° ottobre 2026 o d'accordo. Vi offriamo una vasta area di responsabilità con un sacco di potenziale di sviluppo. La pratica è aperta dal lunedì al venerdì, non forniamo servizi di emergenza e abbiamo cinque settimane di vacanza. Il posto di lavoro si trova nel centro commerciale Glatt, che consente anche di beneficiare dei suoi vantaggi per i dipendenti come sconti in vari negozi e un parcheggio gratuito.

Compiti:
• Personale, leadership professionale e organizzativa del team MPA e degli studenti
• Responsabilità dei controlli di qualità interni ed esterni insieme al coordinatore della pratica
• Assunzione di nuovi dipendenti insieme al coordinatore della pratica e l'introduzione di questi
• Introduzione e attuazione del concetto operativo
• Ottimizzazione dei processi di lavoro nell'area MPA e realizzazione di piccoli progetti
• Scambio regolare con il supporto aziendale, il coordinatore della pratica e il direttore medico
• Inoltre, si assume compiti come MPA nella pratica quotidiana, come l'assistente di consultazione per varie specialità come la chirurgia manuale, ginecologia, medicina familiare, chirurgia plastica, chirurgia viscerale, neurochirurgia e chirurgia vascolare.
• Hai anche la possibilità di assistere con interventi chirurgici in anestesia locale o anestesia generale
• Oltre a effettuare analisi di campioni di sangue e di laboratorio, assicura una pianificazione regolare delle ore di consultazione
• Alla reception è responsabile per la registrazione dei pazienti e per le informazioni telefoniche

Profilo:
• Hai l'EFZ da/per il Med. Assistente pratica e avere l'ulteriore formazione per / al Med. Coordinatore di pratica idealmente già completato con successo o è attualmente in ulteriore istruzione
• Sei una personalità fortemente comunicativa con competenze di leadership, eccelle anche nella responsabilità, nelle competenze sociali, nella resilienza e nella flessibilità e ha un alto orientamento di servizio
• Conduci con passione e gestisci i compiti amministrativi con talento organizzativo
• Sei un giocatore di squadra e incontrare l'intera squadra a livello degli occhi
• Buona SM Conoscenza dell'ufficio, conoscenza di base dei sistemi di informazione clinica e iniziativa completano il tuo profilo

Vantaggi: KSW offre ai dipendenti condizioni che permettono loro di conciliare i loro obiettivi professionali e le esigenze personali. Orario di lavoro flessibile, flessibile, home office e un generoso congedo di maternità e livelli di occupazione adattati a situazioni diverse – tutto questo è possibile a KSW, purché l'azienda lo permetta. Ogni anno, il KSW offre 40 corsi di formazione interdisciplinare e 50 corsi di formazione professionale. Vi sosteniamo anche nel tempo e/o finanziariamente per la formazione esterna.; In situazioni straordinarie, ad esempio B. malattia prolungata, grave stress personale o esperienze difficili nella vita privata, così come nel lavoro quotidiano, sono disponibili varie offerte di conversazione.; La collaborazione apprezzata e amichevole all'interno delle squadre e di tutti i dipartimenti caratterizza l'atmosfera di lavoro a KSW. Come segno di un forte spirito di squadra, il “tu” è stato introdotto come standard al KSW. Inoltre, il KSW supporta eventi di squadra annuali finanziariamente e organizza un grande evento di personale per tutta la casa ogni quattro anni. I dipendenti KSW beneficiano di benefici sociali molto buoni. Così, la soluzione di fondo pensionistico con BVK è molto superiore al minimo legale. Anche in caso di malattia o incidente, i dipendenti KSW sono molto ben coperti.; Con sconti su abbonamenti di fitness, opportunità di formazione interna e offerte di corso, vantaggi in farmacie e presso le più popolari compagnie di assicurazione sanitaria. È possibile beneficiare di un'offerta completa per la vostra salute.; Il nostro centro diurno La Luna con ampie ore di apertura si trova direttamente accanto al KSW. Inoltre, è possibile utilizzare il reddito dipendente, il sostegno finanziario dalla KSW per i costi della culla.; In collaborazione con partner culturali di Winterthur e dintorni, offriamo regolarmente sconti per concerti e spettacoli teatrali. Il prestito dei media nella biblioteca interna è anche gratuito per i dipendenti.

• Area: Centro specialistico Glatt
• Pensum: 80-100 %
descriptionByLocale.en:
The specialist medical center Glatt is a multidisciplinary modern practice operated by the Cantonal Hospital Winterthur. As a supplement to our sympathetic team, we are looking for a Lead Med. Praxisassistentin / Lead Med. Praxisassistenten as of 1 October 2026 or by agreement. We offer you a varied area of responsibility with a lot of development potential. The practice is open Monday to Friday, we do not provide emergency services and have five weeks of vacation. The place of work is located in the shopping center Glatt, which also allows you to benefit from its employee benefits such as discounts in various shops and a free parking space.

Tasks:
• Personnel, professional and organizational leadership of the MPA team and learners
• Responsibility for internal and external quality controls together with the practice coordinator
• Recruitment of new employees together with the practice coordinator and introduction of these
• Introduction and implementation of the operating concept
• Optimization of work processes in the MPA area as well as implementation of small projects
• Regular exchange with the business support, the practice coordinator and the medical director
• In addition, you take on tasks as an MPA in everyday practice, such as the consultation assistant for various specialties such as hand surgery, gynecology, family medicine, plastic surgery, visceral surgery, neurosurgery and vascular surgery.
• You also have the opportunity to assist with surgical interventions in local anesthesia or general anesthesia
• In addition to carrying out blood sampling and laboratory analyses, you ensure smooth consultation hours planning
• At the reception you are responsible for the registration of patients and for telephone information

Profile:
• You have the EFZ to/from the Med. Practice assistant and have the further training for / to the Med. Practice coordinator ideally already successfully completed or is currently in further education
• You are a strong-communicating personality with leadership skills, you also excel in responsibility, social skills, resilience and flexibility and have a high service orientation
• You lead with passion and manage the administrative tasks with organizational talent
• You are a team player and meet the whole team at eye level
• Good MS Office knowledge, basic knowledge of clinic information systems and initiative round off your profile

Benefits: KSW offers employees conditions that enable them to reconcile their professional goals and personal needs. Flexible, flexible working hours, home office as well as a generous maternity leave and employment levels adapted to different situations – all this is possible at KSW, as long as the company allows it. Every year, the KSW offers 40 interdisciplinary and 50 professional training courses. We also support you temporally and/or financially for external training.; In extraordinary situations, e.g. B. prolonged illness, severe personal stress or difficult experiences in private life as well as in everyday work, various offers of conversation are available to you.; The appreciative and friendly cooperation within the teams and across the departments characterizes the working atmosphere at KSW. As a sign of a strong team spirit, the “you” was introduced as a standard at KSW. In addition, the KSW supports annual team events financially and organizes a large staffing event for the whole house every four years. KSW employees benefit from very good social benefits. Thus, the pension fund solution with BVK is far above the legal minimum. Even in the event of illness or accident, KSW employees are very well covered.; With discounts on fitness subscriptions, internal training opportunities and course offers, perks in pharmacies as well as at the most popular health insurance companies. You can benefit from a comprehensive offer for your health.; Our daycare center La Luna with spacious opening hours is located directly next to the KSW. In addition, you can use the income-dependent, financial support from the KSW for the crib costs.; In cooperation with cultural partners in and around Winterthur, we regularly offer discounts for concerts and theatre performances. The borrowing of media in the in-house library is also free of charge for employees.

• Professional field: MPA / Medical Secretariat
• Area: Specialist Centre Glatt
• Pensum: 80-100 %

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le centre médical spécialisé Glatt est une pratique moderne multidisciplinaire gérée par l'hôpital cantonal Winterthur. Comme complément à notre équipe sympathique, nous cherchons un Med Lead. Praxisassistin/Lead Med. Praxisassistensin au 1er octobre 2026 ou par accord. Nous vous offrons une zone de responsabilité variée avec beaucoup de potentiel de développement. La pratique est ouverte du lundi au vendredi, nous ne fournissons pas de services d'urgence et avons cinq semaines de vacances. Le lieu de travail est situé dans le centre commercial Glatt, qui vous permet également de bénéficier de ses avantages pour les employés tels que des réductions dans divers magasins et un parking gratuit.

Tâches :
• Personnel, leadership professionnel et organisationnel de l'équipe de la ZPM et des apprenants
• Responsabilité des contrôles de qualité internes et externes avec le coordonnateur des pratiques
• Recrutement de nouveaux employés avec le coordonnateur de la pratique et introduction de ces
• Introduction et mise en œuvre du concept opérationnel
• Optimisation des processus de travail dans le domaine de la ZPM et mise en œuvre de petits projets
• Échanges réguliers avec le soutien des entreprises, le coordonnateur de la pratique et le directeur médical
• En outre, vous assumez des tâches en tant que MPA dans la pratique quotidienne, comme l'assistante de consultation pour diverses spécialités telles que la chirurgie manuelle, la gynécologie, la médecine familiale, la chirurgie plastique, la chirurgie viscérale, la neurochirurgie et la chirurgie vasculaire.
• Vous avez également la possibilité d'assister à des interventions chirurgicales en anesthésie locale ou en anesthésie générale
• En plus d'effectuer des prélèvements sanguins et des analyses de laboratoire, vous assurez une planification des heures de consultation en douceur
• A la réception, vous êtes responsable de l'enregistrement des patients et des informations téléphoniques

Profil :
• Vous avez l'EFZ du Med. Assistant de pratique et avoir la formation continue pour / pour le Med. Coordinateur de la pratique idéalement déjà achevé ou est actuellement en formation continue
• Vous êtes une personnalité forte et communicatrice avec des compétences en leadership, vous excellez également dans la responsabilité, les compétences sociales, la résilience et la flexibilité et avez une orientation de service élevée
• Vous dirigez avec passion et gérez les tâches administratives avec talent organisationnel
• Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe et rencontrez toute l'équipe au niveau des yeux
• Bonne EM Les connaissances de bureau, les connaissances de base des systèmes d'information des cliniques et l'initiative complètent votre profil

Avantages: KSW offre aux employés des conditions qui leur permettent de concilier leurs objectifs professionnels et leurs besoins personnels. Des horaires flexibles et flexibles, un bureau à domicile ainsi qu'un congé de maternité généreux et des niveaux d'emploi adaptés à différentes situations – tout cela est possible chez KSW, tant que l'entreprise le permet. Chaque année, le KSW propose 40 formations interdisciplinaires et 50 formations professionnelles. Nous vous soutenons également temporairement et/ou financièrement pour la formation externe; Dans des situations extraordinaires, comme une maladie prolongée de B., un stress personnel grave ou des expériences difficiles dans la vie privée ainsi que dans le travail quotidien, diverses offres de conversation vous sont offertes. La coopération reconnaissante et amicale au sein des équipes et des départements caractérise l'atmosphère de travail de KSW. Comme signe d'un fort esprit d'équipe, le -you , a été introduit comme un standard chez KSW. De plus, le KSW appuie financièrement les activités annuelles de l'équipe et organise tous les quatre ans un important événement de dotation pour toute la maison. Les employés de KSW bénéficient de très bons avantages sociaux. Ainsi, la solution de fonds de pension avec BVK est bien au-dessus du minimum légal. Même en cas de maladie ou d'accident, les employés de KSW sont très bien couverts. Avec des rabais sur les abonnements de fitness, des possibilités de formation interne et des cours, avantages dans les pharmacies ainsi que dans les compagnies d'assurance santé les plus populaires. Vous pouvez bénéficier d'une offre complète pour votre santé; Notre garderie La Luna avec des heures d'ouverture spacieuses est située directement à côté de la KSW. De plus, vous pouvez utiliser le soutien financier de la KSW, qui dépend du revenu, pour les coûts du lit. En collaboration avec des partenaires culturels de Winterthur et des environs, nous offrons régulièrement des réductions pour les concerts et les spectacles de théâtre. L'emprunt des médias dans la bibliothèque interne est également gratuit pour les employés.

jobs.description:
Für unseren modernen Operationsbetrieb suchen wir eine Fachperson Operationslagerungen oder eine Fachperson Gesundheit mit Interesse an der spannenden Tätigkeit als Fachperson Operationslagerung. Unsere vielfältigen Fachgebiete Viszeral-, Gefäss-, Neuro-, Kinderchirurgie, Hand-/Plastische Chirurgie, Traumatologie, Orthopädie, Urologie, Gynäkologie sowie ORL bietet dir garantiert einen abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag in einem motivierten Team.

Aufgaben:

• Du triffst eine gezielte und auf die Patientin bzw. den Patienten und die Operationsmethode abgestimmte Auswahl an Lagerungsmaterialien
• Während der Operation überprüfst du die Operationslagerung kontinuierlich und hast somit einen entscheidenden Einfluss auf die Patientensicherheit

• Die Kundenorientierung und qualitativ, fachgerechte Lagerung von Patientinnen und Patienten sind für dich selbstverständlich
• Du besitzt gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie eine gute körperliche Verfassung
• Deine kommunikative und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit unterstützt die interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit in unserem Operationsbetrieb

Tasks:

• You keep track even in more demanding situations and do not let yourself get out of peace

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und qualifizierte medizinisch-technische Radiologiefachperson HF (MTR HF) für den Bereich interventionelle Radiologie.

• Enge interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Ärztinnen und Ärzten, Pflegepersonal und weiteren Fachbereichen

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di gruppo specializzato indipendente, l'assistenza post-assistenza e la consulenza sociale dell'Ospedale cantonale Winterthur fa parte del team di trattamento interdisciplinare e garantisce un'assistenza integrata con soluzioni di assistenza praticabili e sostenibili. Siamo alla ricerca di un rinforzo e non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione come responsabile del caso / assistente sociale / assistenza sociale e consulenza sociale.

Compiti:
• Condividi la responsabilità per una gestione efficace delle uscite insieme a tutti gli specialisti coinvolti nella cura
• Percepire un ruolo centrale nel follow-up e nella consulenza sociale nel processo di recupero del paziente
• Una stretta collaborazione con vari gruppi professionali all'interno e all'esterno della KSW
• Sviluppo e realizzazione di soluzioni per il miglior reinserimento possibile nella società, nella vita familiare e professionale
• Rete attiva e coordinamento con enti interni ed esterni
• Lavoro in un ambiente apprezzativo e positivo con alto riconoscimento del lavoro

Profilo:
• Formazione completata presso un college di scienze applicate per il lavoro sociale o per l'ulteriore istruzione nella gestione dei casi. Formazione medica di base completa il tuo profilo
• Iniziativa, personalità flessibile e resiliente
• La cooperazione interdisciplinare e la cooperazione con centri consultivi esterni e istituzioni
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e alto impegno per soluzioni ottimali per pazienti e parenti
• Molto buone capacità di consulenza e gestione sicura di diversi interessi e aspettative
• Esperienza professionale in un ospedale acuto, riabilitazione ospedaliera o in un ambiente simile complesso

Vantaggi: KSW offre ai dipendenti condizioni che permettono loro di conciliare i loro obiettivi professionali e le esigenze personali. Vi sosteniamo anche nel tempo e/o finanziariamente con la formazione esterna.; In situazioni straordinarie, ad esempio B. malattia prolungata, grave stress personale o esperienze difficili nella vita privata, così come nel lavoro quotidiano, varie offerte di conversazione sono a vostra disposizione.; La collaborazione apprezzata e amichevole all'interno delle squadre e nei dipartimenti caratterizza l'atmosfera di lavoro a KSW. Come segno di un forte spirito di squadra, il “tu” è stato introdotto come standard a KSW. Inoltre, il KSW supporta eventi di squadra annuali finanziariamente e organizza un grande evento di personale per tutta la casa ogni quattro anni. I dipendenti KSW beneficiano di benefici sociali molto buoni. Così, la soluzione di fondo pensionistico con BVK è molto superiore al minimo legale. Anche in caso di malattia o incidente, i dipendenti KSW sono molto ben coperti.; Con sconti su abbonamenti di fitness, opportunità di formazione interna e offerte di corso, vantaggi in farmacie e presso le più popolari compagnie di assicurazione sanitaria. È possibile beneficiare di un'offerta completa per la vostra salute.; Il nostro centro diurno La Luna con ampie ore di apertura si trova vicino al KSW. Inoltre, è possibile utilizzare il reddito dipendente, il sostegno finanziario dalla KSW per i costi della culla.; In collaborazione con partner culturali di Winterthur e dintorni, offriamo regolarmente sconti per concerti e spettacoli teatrali. Il prestito dei media nella biblioteca interna è anche gratuito per i dipendenti.

• Pensum: 90%
descriptionByLocale.en:
As an independent specialist group, the aftercare and social consultancy of the Cantonal Hospital Winterthur is part of the interdisciplinary treatment team and ensures integrated care with viable and sustainable aftercare solutions. We are looking for a reinforcement and look forward to your application as a case manager / social worker / aftercare and social consultancy.

Tasks:
• Share responsibility for effective exit management together with all specialists involved in the care
• Perceiving a central role in follow-up and social counselling in the patient recovery process
• Close cooperation with various professional groups within and outside the KSW
• Development and implementation of solutions for the best possible reintegration into society, family and professional life
• Active networking and coordination with internal and external bodies
• Work in an appreciative, positive environment with high recognition of your work

Profile:
• Completed training at a college of applied sciences for social work or further education in case management. Basic medical training rounds off your profile
• Initiative, flexible and resilient personality
• Enjoying interdisciplinary cooperation as well as cooperation with external advisory centres and institutions
• Strong communication skills and high commitment to optimal solutions for patients and relatives
• Very good consulting skills and safe handling of different interests and expectations
• Professional experience in an acute hospital, in inpatient rehabilitation or in a comparable complex environment

Benefits: KSW offers employees conditions that enable them to reconcile their professional goals and personal needs. Flexible, flexible working hours, home office as well as a generous maternity leave and employment levels adapted to different situations – all this is possible at KSW, as long as the company allows it. Every year, the KSW offers 40 interdisciplinary and 50 professional training courses. We also support you temporally and/or financially with external training.; In extraordinary situations, e.g. B. prolonged illness, severe personal stress or difficult experiences in private life as well as in everyday work, various offers of conversation are available to you.; The appreciative and friendly cooperation within the teams and across the departments characterizes the working atmosphere at KSW. As a sign of a strong team spirit, the “you” was introduced as a standard at KSW. In addition, the KSW supports annual team events financially and organizes a large staffing event for the whole house every four years. KSW employees benefit from very good social benefits. Thus, the pension fund solution with BVK is far above the legal minimum. Even in the event of illness or accident, KSW employees are very well covered.; With discounts on fitness subscriptions, internal training opportunities and course offers, perks in pharmacies as well as at the most popular health insurance companies. You can benefit from a comprehensive offer for your health.; Our daycare center La Luna with spacious opening hours is located next to the KSW. In addition, you can use the income-dependent, financial support from the KSW for the crib costs.; In cooperation with cultural partners in and around Winterthur, we regularly offer discounts for concerts and theater performances. The borrowing of media in the in-house library is also free of charge for employees.

• Professional field: Various professions
• Area: aftercare and social counselling
• Pensum: 90%

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Clinic for Radiology and Nuclear Medicine at KSW carries out more than 105,000 examinations and interventions per year. It offers the highest level of expertise in various fields such as X-ray, breast imaging, ultrasound, nuclear medicine, MRI, CT, paediatric radiology, neuroradiology and interventional radiology. You want something new – without leaving radiology completely? Then you are exactly right with us: Our disposition is looking for a committed personality with organizational talent who values everyday practice as much as contact with people. And best of all: With us you work at regular times without weekend services. In addition, we offer one day of home office per week – for more flexibility in your everyday life.

Tasks:
• Close communication: You are in close contact with our referees, patients and staff
• First contact person: You represent our clinic as first contact person
• Scheduling and planning: You coordinate examinations in various diagnostic areas such as ultrasound, CT, MRI, interventional radiology, mammography and conventional diagnostics
• Turntable function: You assume an important role as a connecting point and create security and trust with our patients and our customers through your social and personal competence

Profile:
• Ideally, you will have an MTR education and a few years of professional experience in this or a related area of health care.
• You are known as an organizational talent, and you are good at keeping an overview
• You are customer-oriented and your working style is characterized by a high quality awareness
• You like working in a team and are not afraid to take responsibility

Benefits: KSW offers employees conditions that enable them to reconcile their professional goals and personal needs. Flexible, flexible working hours, home office as well as a generous maternity leave and employment levels adapted to different situations – all this is possible at KSW, as long as the company allows it. Every year, the KSW offers 40 interdisciplinary and 50 professional training courses. We also support you temporally and/or financially with external training.; In extraordinary situations, e.g. B. prolonged illness, severe personal stress or difficult experiences in private life as well as in everyday work, various offers of conversation are available to you.; The appreciative and friendly cooperation within the teams and across the departments characterizes the working atmosphere at KSW. As a sign of a strong team spirit, the “you” was introduced as a standard at KSW. In addition, the KSW supports annual team events financially and organizes a large staffing event for the whole house every four years. KSW employees benefit from very good social benefits. Thus, the pension fund solution with BVK is far above the legal minimum. Even in the event of illness or accident, KSW employees are very well covered.; With discounts on fitness subscriptions, internal training opportunities and course offers, perks in pharmacies as well as at the most popular health insurance companies. You can benefit from a comprehensive offer for your health.; Our daycare center La Luna with spacious opening hours is located next to the KSW. In addition, you can use the income-dependent, financial support from the KSW for the crib costs.; In cooperation with cultural partners in and around Winterthur, we regularly offer discounts for concerts and theater performances. The borrowing of media in the in-house library is also free of charge for employees.

• Area: Clinic for Radiology and Nuclear Medicine
• Pensum: 80-100 %
